full_text_en:
Guo Liwen and Harbin Magnetizer Factory v. Gaochun County Lamp Decoration Company, Nanjing Dongfang Glass General Factory, Nanjing Yuedong Industrial Company, and Kunming Cultural Supplies Company — dispute over infringement of patent, registered trademark exclusive right, and legal person name right

Plaintiff: Guo Liwen, male, 50 years old, Factory Director of Harbin Magnetizer Factory.

Agent ad litem: Ma Jiaji, Manager of the Kunming Business Division of Harbin Magnetizer Factory.

Plaintiff: Harbin Magnetizer Factory.

Legal Representative: Guo Liwen, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Yang Xi'an, Attorney at Yunnan Law Firm.

Defendant: Gaochun County Ceramic Lamp Decoration Joint Company of Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Wu Xiangyu, Manager.

Defendant: Nanjing Dongfang Glass General Factory.

Legal Representative: Chen Yansheng, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Liang Jianxin, Deputy Factory Director of Dongfang Glass General Factory.

Defendant: Nanjing Yuedong Industrial Company.

Legal Representative: Chen Yansheng, Manager.

Agent ad litem: Huang Xiang, Staff of Yuedong Industrial Company.

Defendant: Kunming Cultural Supplies Company of Yunnan Province.

Legal Representative: Xie Zhengbang, Manager.

Agent ad litem: Xue Bosi, Assistant Manager of Cultural Supplies Company.

Plaintiffs Guo Liwen and Harbin Magnetizer Factory (hereinafter referred to as the Magnetizer Factory) filed an action with the Intermediate People's Court of Kunming, Yunnan Province against defendants Gaochun County Ceramic Lamp Decoration Joint Company of Jiangsu Province (hereinafter referred to as the Lamp Decoration Company), Nanjing Dongfang Glass General Factory (hereinafter referred to as the Glass General Factory), Nanjing Yuedong Industrial Company (hereinafter referred to as Yuedong Company), and Kunming Cultural Supplies Company (hereinafter referred to as Cultural Supplies Company) concerning a dispute over infringement of patent, registered trademark exclusive right, and legal person name right.

Plaintiff Guo Liwen alleged: On August 16, 1989, the plaintiff obtained the patent right for the H-type strong-field magnetized cup and entered into a license implementation agreement with the Magnetizer Factory. However, the defendant Lamp Decoration Company manufactured counterfeit Ha Magnetic Cups and printed the plaintiff's patent number on the cup shells, thereby infringing upon the plaintiff's patent right. The defendants Glass General Factory and Yuedong Company, knowing that such magnetic cups were counterfeit, sold them, thus also infringing upon the plaintiff's patent right. The plaintiff requests that the civil liability of each defendant for infringement be investigated and that the plaintiff's economic losses be compensated.

Plaintiff Magnetizer Factory alleged: In order to repay a debt of over 200,000 yuan owed to the Glass General Factory, the defendant Lamp Decoration Company manufactured 19,740 counterfeit "Ha Magnetic Cups" and used them to offset the debt at 11 yuan each. The Yuedong Company, affiliated with the Glass General Factory, then sold 7,920 of these cups to the defendant Cultural Supplies Company at 13 yuan each. The aforementioned three defendants counterfeited the plaintiff's factory name and infringed upon the plaintiff's registered trademark exclusive right. The plaintiff requests that the Lamp Decoration Company compensate for economic losses of 80,540 yuan, and that the Glass General Factory and Yuedong Company each compensate 15,000 yuan. The Cultural Supplies Company, upon receiving the goods, discovered they were counterfeit "magnetic cups" and did not sell them; therefore, the plaintiff does not request economic compensation from it.

The defendants Lamp Decoration Company, Glass General Factory, and Yuedong Company all stated that they would not submit a defense.

Defendant Cultural Supplies Company argued: After purchasing the goods from Yuedong Company, the defendant discovered that the magnetic cups received did not match the sample and did not sell them; thus, no infringement occurred, and the defendant should not be liable for compensating the plaintiffs' losses.

The Intermediate People's Court of Kunming found the following facts through trial: Plaintiff Guo Liwen obtained the patent for the H-type strong-field magnetized cup on August 16, 1989, with patent number 38205378.7, and entered into a license implementation agreement with the Magnetizer Factory. From November 1992 to January 1993, because the defendant Lamp Decoration Company owed the defendant Glass General Factory over 200,000 yuan in payment for goods, the two parties agreed that the Lamp Decoration Company would manufacture "Ha Magnetic Cups" to offset the debt. Subsequently, the Lamp Decoration Company purchased counterfeit "Ha Magnetic Cup" shells from Zhejiang Province (with the shells bearing Guo Liwen's H-type strong-field magnetized cup patent number, the Magnetizer Factory's factory name, and the Ha Magnetic Cup registered trademark), purchased cup liners from Gaochun County Daily-Use Porcelain Factory of Jiangsu Province, organized magnetic strips on its own, and assembled a batch of counterfeit "Ha Magnetic Cups." Of these, 19,740 cups were delivered to the Glass General Factory to offset a debt of 217,140 yuan at 11 yuan each. In May 1993, the Glass General Factory, under the name of the defendant Yuedong Company, entered into a contract with the defendant Cultural Supplies Company for the purchase and sale of these "Ha Magnetic Cups." The Cultural Supplies Company paid Yuedong Company 100,000 yuan, and after receiving 8,160 "Ha Magnetic Cups," discovered they were counterfeit and did not sell them.

The Intermediate People's Court of Kunming held: The defendant Lamp Decoration Company, in order to obtain illegal profits, counterfeited plaintiff Guo Liwen's patent number and manufactured counterfeit "Ha Magnetic Cups," which constitutes the act of "counterfeiting the patent of another person" as stipulated in Article 63 of the Patent Law of the PRC and shall be dealt with in accordance with Article 60 of the Patent Law. Article 3 of the Trademark Law of the PRC provides that a trademark registrant enjoys the exclusive right to use the trademark, which is protected by law. The Lamp Decoration Company used the Magnetizer Factory's registered "Ha Magnetic" trademark and factory name on the counterfeit "Ha Magnetic Cups," an act that not only violates Article 38(1) of the Trademark Law regarding the use of the same trademark on the same goods without the permission of the trademark registrant, but also violates Article 120(2) of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC regarding the inviolability of a legal person's name right. The defendant Glass General Factory, knowing that the Lamp Decoration Company was not the manufacturer of "Ha Magnetic Cups," agreed to accept the manufactured counterfeit "Ha Magnetic Cups" in payment of the debt and allowed the defendant Yuedong Company to sell them, which constitutes an infringing act under Article 38(2) of the Trademark Law regarding "selling goods that are known to bear a counterfeit registered trademark." The Lamp Decoration Company, Glass General Factory, and Yuedong Company shall each bear tort liability for compensating losses according to law. The defendant Cultural Supplies Company, upon receiving the "Ha Magnetic Cups," discovered that the products were counterfeit and did not sell them, thus no infringement occurred, and it shall not bear liability for compensation. Accordingly, the Intermediate People's Court of Kunming rendered the following judgment on October 29, 1993:

The defendant Lamp Decoration Company shall compensate plaintiff Guo Liwen 11,844 yuan and compensate plaintiff Magnetizer Factory 68,700 yuan. The defendant Glass General Factory shall compensate the Magnetizer Factory 15,000 yuan and compensate Guo Liwen 3,948 yuan. The defendant Yuedong Company shall compensate the Magnetizer Factory 15,000 yuan and compensate Guo Liwen 3,948 yuan.

Court acceptance fee of 5,818.70 yuan shall be borne by the Lamp Decoration Company in the amount of 3,491.22 yuan, by the Glass General Factory in the amount of 1,163.74 yuan, and by the Yuedong Company in the amount of 1,163.74 yuan.

After the judgment of the first instance was announced, none of the parties filed an appeal.
